    """Convert 1 <= n <= 3999 to a Roman numeral using subtractive notation (IV, IX, XL, ...)."""

        100, 90, 50, 40,
        10, 9, 5, 4,

    ]

        "C", "XC", "L", "XL",
        "X", "IX", "V", "IV",

    return roman_num
